indications_and_usage: KEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.
dosage_and_administration: The recommended dose is 200 mg every 3 weeks.
contraindications: KEYTRUDA is contraindicated in patients with severe hypersensitivity.
adverse_reactions: Fatigue, nausea, and rash were commonly reported.
drug_interactions: No formal drug interaction studies have been conducted.
clinical_studies: Efficacy was demonstrated in a randomized clinical trial.
